adjudicated.jp: 脱走させないための門は、とにかく厳めしいという印象があった。
adjudicated.en: This gate to prevent escape somehow still left an impression of austere dignity.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: なぜ脱走させてはいけないか。
adjudicated.en: Why is escape so strictly forbidden?
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 人を傷つける可能性があるから。
adjudicated.en: Because there is a possibility that people would be hurt.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: ま、一種の半隔離施設だ。
adjudicated.en: Well, it's kind of a half-isolation facility.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 安心していい、危険人物たちは滅びました。
adjudicated.en: Be at ease now, the dangerous people have been annihilated.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 世界中に八人だけです。
adjudicated.en: There are only eight people all throughout the world.
comments: These random assurances that there's no one out there sound less like desperation and more like foreknowledge. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: あと一般市民も滅びました。
adjudicated.en: And the general public had also been annihilated.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: だから被害者は出ません。
adjudicated.en: Therefore there shall be no victims.
adjudicated.assessment: The English is supportable by the bound Japanese source in this unit.

adjudicated.jp: 「と、自虐ネタはここまでにして」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "And, the jokes tending towards the masochistic end here."
adjudicated.assessment: The Japanese term means self-deprecating or self-mocking; it does not mean masochistic here.

adjudicated.jp: 死んだ貝のように開いたままの門を抜ける。
adjudicated.en: I pass through this gate open like a dead shellfish.
